source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: When the earth is shaken with a violent shaking and brings out what is in its belly — the dead and the treasures — and man asks in alarm: what has happened to it?
tafsir.muyassar-2: When the earth is shaken with a violent shaking and brings out what is in its belly — the dead and the treasures — and man asks in alarm: what has happened to it?
tafsir.muyassar-3: When the earth is shaken with a violent shaking and brings out what is in its belly — the dead and the treasures — and man asks in alarm: what has happened to it?
tafsir.muyassar-4: On the Day of Resurrection the earth will report what was done upon it, good or evil, because God Almighty commanded it to report what was done upon it.
tafsir.muyassar-5: On the Day of Resurrection the earth will report what was done upon it, good or evil, because God Almighty commanded it to report what was done upon it.
tafsir.muyassar-6: On that day people will return from the place of reckoning in separate groups, so that God shows them what they did of good and evil deeds and recompenses them for it.
tafsir.muyassar-7: Whoever does the weight of a tiny ant of good will see its reward in the Hereafter, and whoever does the weight of a tiny ant of evil will see its punishment in the Hereafter.
tafsir.muyassar-8: Whoever does the weight of a tiny ant of good will see its reward in the Hereafter, and whoever does the weight of a tiny ant of evil will see its punishment in the Hereafter.
